name: Config Governance
description: Governs your agent configuration — instruction files, agent files, Skills, characters, templates and prompt overrides: finds outdated, conflicting and stale rules, checks whether rules are actually followed in past sessions, enforces the ones that are not, and verifies that a change helped.
author: cognia-next

permissionJustifications.agent-config:read: Reads your instruction files, agent files, Skills, characters, templates and prompt overrides through the app, plus a structural summary of hooks, permission rules and MCP servers — never their contents.
permissionJustifications.agent-config:write: Writes the changes you select back through each owner. The app asks you to confirm every surface's change before it is written.
permissionJustifications.ai:chat: Judges each surface with your configured model, checks rule pairs for conflicts, and turns rules about tool use into checks. Text is redacted before it is sent.
permissionJustifications.session:read: Replays tool calls from your past sessions to measure whether each rule was followed.
permissionJustifications.project:read: Lists your workspaces so you can audit each one, and finds a workspace's folders for path checks and eval runs.
permissionJustifications.extension:ui: Opens its own view from the command and the quick action.
permissionJustifications.hooks:chat-intercept: Runs the enforcement rules you adopt on tool calls: reminding the agent of a rule, or blocking a call that breaks it.
permissionJustifications.tests:run: Runs an eval dataset you pick before and after a change, to measure whether the change helped.
permissionJustifications.database:write: Records the eval runs you start.

tools.name: config_governance_report
tools.description: Read the latest audit of this workspace's agent configuration (instruction files, Skills, agents, prompts): findings with location, quoted evidence, pattern, confidence and proposed action. refresh=true re-runs the audit first (model calls). Read-only: changes are applied by the user in the Config Governance view.

refresh.description: Re-run before answering instead of returning the stored result.

tools.name: config_governance_adherence
tools.description: Read how often each checkable rule of this workspace's agent configuration was followed in past sessions. refresh=true replays the checks over recent sessions first (local, no model call). Read-only.

refresh.description: Re-run before answering instead of returning the stored result.

en.manifest.name: Config Governance
en.manifest.description: Governs your agent configuration — instruction files, agent files, Skills, characters, templates and prompt overrides: finds outdated, conflicting and stale rules, checks whether rules are actually followed in past sessions, enforces the ones that are not, and verifies that a change helped.
en.commands.governance.description: Audit agent configuration or check rule adherence: /governance [audit|adherence|open]
en.config.auditShipped.title: Audit shipped prompts
en.config.auditShipped.description: Also audit prompts that ship with the app and that you have not changed.
en.config.auditModel.title: Audit model
en.config.auditModel.description: The model that judges your configuration. Empty uses your default model.
en.config.targetModel.title: Target model
en.config.targetModel.description: The model your configuration is written for. Empty uses your default model.
en.config.backtestSessionLimit.title: Sessions to replay
en.config.backtestSessionLimit.description: How many recent sessions the adherence check replays.
en.config.enforcementEnabled.title: Run enforcement rules
en.config.enforcementEnabled.description: Apply the enforcement rules you adopted to tool calls. Turn off to pause all of them.
en.view.inactive: Config Governance is not running. Enable the plugin to use it.
en.errors.busy: Another governance operation is still running.
en.errors.noModel: No model is configured. Set a default model or the audit model in this plugin's settings.
en.overview.intro: Three questions about every rule your agent loads: should it exist, is it followed, and did changing it help.
en.overview.auditCost: Reads every listed surface and makes one model call per surface, plus one for conflicts.
en.overview.never: This workspace has not been audited yet.
en.overview.questions: Findings marked “keep” are rules you decided should stay; they are left out of these counts.
en.overview.modelChanged: The audit judged this configuration for {from}, but your target model is now {to}. Run the audit again — what is dated depends on the model.
en.notes.surfaces-capped: {count} more surfaces were over the limit and not audited.
en.notes.facts-unavailable: Hooks and permission rules could not be read; the judgment ran without them.
en.notes.references-failed: {count} surface(s) could not check their paths and scripts.
en.notes.judge-failed: {count} surface(s) got deterministic checks only because the model call failed.
en.notes.hunk-withheld: {count} proposed edit(s) were withheld (redacted text, an overlap, or a missing destination).
en.notes.findings-capped: {count} findings were found; only the first are kept.
en.explain.pressure-language: Shouted emphasis or hedging without a reason. Current models over-apply shouted rules and under-deliver hedged ones.
en.explain.thinking-scaffold: Prose that steers reasoning depth; that is a model setting now.
en.explain.output-choreography: A fixed cadence or a numeric length cap; state the audience and the outcome instead.
en.explain.over-specification: Step scripts, repetition or grader vocabulary for a judgment task.
en.explain.fossil: A workaround for an older model, a retired model name, or a ban that no longer fits.
en.explain.prohibition-without-provenance: A run of prohibitions with no stated reason.
en.explain.unenforced-instruction: A behavior a hook or permission rule could enforce deterministically.
en.explain.stale-fact: The repository no longer has the path or script this names.
en.explain.history-narrative: Incident numbers, “last time we…” or date conditionals; state the current rule instead.
en.explain.brittle-skill: The Skill is too long to read in one sitting.
en.explain.trigger-enumeration: The description lists example queries instead of naming what the Skill is for.
en.explain.conflict: Two surfaces loaded together say different things.
en.explain.unused-skill: The Skill is enabled but has never been used.
en.explain.unfollowed-rule: Past sessions broke this rule often; prose is not doing the job. Consider enforcing it with a tool hook.
en.explain.diluted-rule: The rule holds early in long sessions and breaks later: it loses weight as context grows. Its position, not its wording, is the likely fix.
en.explain.untriggered-rule: No replayed session ever reached a point where this rule applied. It may be obsolete.
en.findings.none: No findings yet. Run the audit from the Overview tab.
en.findings.applyHint: Each surface's change is shown for confirmation before it is written. Conflict and stale-fact edits are never selected for you.
en.findings.proposedOnlyHint: This edit depends on text anyone with commit access can write, so it is not selected automatically.
en.findings.adherenceLine: Followed {followed} of {opportunities} times in replayed sessions.
en.applyStatus.stale: {name}: changed since the audit — run the audit again
en.adherence.hint: Deriving turns rules about tool use into checks (one model call). Replaying runs them over recent sessions locally, with no model call.
en.adherence.none: No checks yet. Derive them from your rules first.
en.adherence.noChecks: None of your rules are about observable tool use, so there is nothing to replay.
en.adherence.derivedSummary: {checks} checks · {notCheckable} rules not checkable · {rejected} rejected · derived {at}
en.adherence.dilution: Breaks more often late in long sessions: {early} early vs {late} late.
en.adherence.labels: {count} sample(s) labeled “not a match”; labels apply on the next replay.
en.enforcement.hint: Adopted rules run on every tool call: “remind” appends the rule to the tool's result; “block” stops the call and tells the agent why.
en.enforcement.none: No enforcement rules. Adopt one from a rule that is not followed.
en.enforcement.disabledBySetting: Enforcement is turned off in this plugin's settings; no rule is running.
en.enforcement.adoptPrompt: Enforce this rule in this workspace's sessions:
en.enforcement.afterAlwaysReminds: A “must follow” rule cannot block a call that has not happened yet, so it reminds instead.
en.verify.adherenceTitle: Adherence before and after a change
en.verify.adherenceHint: Replays the current checks over sessions created before an applied change and over sessions created since.
en.verify.noChanges: No changes applied from this view yet.
en.verify.noChecks: No checks to compare. Derive checks on the Adherence tab.
en.verify.evalHint: Runs an eval dataset in this workspace before a change (baseline) and after it (candidate). Each run spends model calls.
en.verify.evalNeedsWorkspace: Pick a workspace: an eval run loads the instructions of its folder.
en.verify.noDatasets: No eval datasets. Create one in Evals first.
en.inventory.factsLine: {hooks} hooks · {rules} permission rules · {servers} MCP servers · {skills} of {skillsTotal} Skills enabled
en.inventory.hooksUnavailable: Hooks can only be read in the desktop app.
en.inventory.factsPrivacy: Settings that can hold secrets are summarized by the app; their contents are never read by this plugin or sent to a model.
en.drift.title: Agent configuration changed
en.drift.body: {changed} surface(s) changed and {findings} new high-confidence finding(s) since the last audit. Open Config Governance to review.
en.report.auditSummary: {surfaces} surfaces · {findings} findings ({high} high confidence) · {hunks} proposed edits · judged for {model}
en.report.more: …and {count} more in the Config Governance view.
en.report.noChecks: None of the rules are about observable tool use.
en.slash.openHint: Review and apply changes in the Config Governance view.
en.errors.unparseable: The model did not answer in the expected format. Try again or choose another audit model.
en.errors.recordTooLarge: This is too large to keep in the plugin's storage. Remove some rules or findings and try again.
en.errors.unsafePattern: The command pattern is not allowed: it is empty, too long, or could run too slowly.
en.errors.stale: The text changed since it was read. Re-run the audit and try again.

zh-CN.manifest.name: 配置治理
zh-CN.manifest.description: 治理你的智能体配置——指令文件、智能体文件、技能、角色、模板与提示词覆盖：找出过时、冲突和失效的规则，检查规则在历史会话中是否真的被遵守，对未被遵守的规则加以强制，并验证改动是否带来改善。
zh-CN.commands.governance.description: 审计智能体配置或检查规则遵守情况：/governance [audit|adherence|open]
zh-CN.config.auditShipped.title: 审计内置提示词
zh-CN.config.auditShipped.description: 同时审计应用自带、你未修改过的提示词。
zh-CN.config.auditModel.title: 审计模型
zh-CN.config.auditModel.description: 用于评判配置的模型。留空则使用默认模型。
zh-CN.config.targetModel.title: 目标模型
zh-CN.config.targetModel.description: 你的配置所面向的模型。留空则使用默认模型。
zh-CN.config.backtestSessionLimit.title: 回放会话数
zh-CN.config.backtestSessionLimit.description: 遵守情况检查回放的最近会话数量。
zh-CN.config.enforcementEnabled.title: 运行强制规则
zh-CN.config.enforcementEnabled.description: 将你采纳的强制规则应用到工具调用。关闭即暂停全部规则。
zh-CN.view.inactive: 配置治理未运行。请先启用该插件。
zh-CN.errors.busy: 另一项治理操作仍在进行。
zh-CN.errors.noModel: 未配置模型。请设置默认模型，或在本插件设置中指定审计模型。
zh-CN.overview.intro: 针对智能体加载的每条规则回答三个问题：它该不该存在、是否被遵守、修改后是否更好。
zh-CN.overview.auditCost: 会读取列出的每个配置面，每个配置面调用一次模型，冲突检查另调用一次。
zh-CN.overview.lastRun: 上次审计 {at} · {surfaces} 个配置面 · 按 {model} 评判
zh-CN.overview.questions: 标记为“保留”的发现是你决定继续保留的规则，不计入以上数量。
zh-CN.overview.modelChanged: 上次审计是按 {from} 评判的，而你现在的目标模型是 {to}。请重新审计——什么算过时取决于模型。
zh-CN.notes.surfaces-capped: 另有 {count} 个配置面超出上限，未被审计。
zh-CN.notes.facts-unavailable: 无法读取钩子和权限规则，评判在缺少它们的情况下进行。
zh-CN.notes.references-failed: {count} 个配置面无法检查其中的路径和脚本。
zh-CN.notes.judge-failed: {count} 个配置面因模型调用失败，只做了确定性检查。
zh-CN.notes.hunk-withheld: {count} 处拟议修改被扣留（涉及脱敏文本、相互重叠或缺少目标位置）。
zh-CN.notes.findings-capped: 共发现 {count} 条，仅保留前面的部分。
zh-CN.explain.pressure-language: 没有给出理由的大写强调或含糊措辞。当前模型会过度执行被强调的规则，对含糊的要求则执行不足。
zh-CN.explain.thinking-scaffold: 试图引导推理深度的措辞；这现在由模型设置决定。
zh-CN.explain.output-choreography: 固定的汇报节奏或字数上限；应改为说明受众和期望结果。
zh-CN.explain.over-specification: 为判断类任务写死步骤、重复强调或使用评分用语。
zh-CN.explain.fossil: 为旧模型准备的变通写法、已退役的模型名，或已不再适用的禁令。
zh-CN.explain.prohibition-without-provenance: 一连串没有说明理由的禁令。
zh-CN.explain.unenforced-instruction: 可以由钩子或权限规则确定性执行的行为要求。
zh-CN.explain.stale-fact: 仓库中已不存在这里提到的路径或脚本。
zh-CN.explain.history-narrative: 事故编号、“上次我们……”或日期条件；应直接写出当前规则。
zh-CN.explain.brittle-skill: 该技能过长，难以一次读完。
zh-CN.explain.trigger-enumeration: 描述罗列了示例问句，而不是说明该技能的用途。
zh-CN.explain.conflict: 同时加载的两个配置面说法不一致。
zh-CN.explain.unused-skill: 该技能已启用，但从未被使用。
zh-CN.explain.unfollowed-rule: 历史会话经常违反这条规则，靠文字说明并不奏效。可以考虑用工具钩子强制执行。
zh-CN.explain.diluted-rule: 这条规则在长会话前段能被遵守、后段被打破：随着上下文增长它的分量被稀释。更可能需要调整的是它的位置，而不是措辞。
zh-CN.explain.untriggered-rule: 回放的会话中从未出现适用这条规则的情形，它可能已经过时。
zh-CN.findings.none: 暂无发现。请在“概览”标签页中开始审计。
zh-CN.findings.applyHint: 每个配置面的改动在写入前都会展示给你确认。冲突和失效事实类的修改不会被自动选中。
zh-CN.findings.proposedOnlyHint: 该修改依赖任何有提交权限的人都能写入的文本，因此不会被自动选中。
zh-CN.findings.adherenceLine: 在回放的会话中遵守了 {followed}/{opportunities} 次。
zh-CN.applyStatus.stale: {name}：审计后已被修改——请重新审计
zh-CN.apply.summary: 对 {name} 应用 {count} 处治理改动
zh-CN.adherence.hint: “生成”会把与工具使用相关的规则转换为检查项（调用一次模型）。“回放”在本地对最近的会话运行这些检查，不调用模型。
zh-CN.adherence.none: 暂无检查项。请先根据你的规则生成。
zh-CN.adherence.noChecks: 你的规则都不涉及可观察的工具使用，没有可回放的内容。
zh-CN.adherence.derivedSummary: {checks} 个检查项 · {notCheckable} 条规则不可检查 · {rejected} 条被拒绝 · 生成于 {at}
zh-CN.adherence.resultLine: 遵守率 {rate}（{followed}/{opportunities}）· 在 {scanned} 个会话中的 {sessions} 个里适用
zh-CN.adherence.dilution: 在长会话后段更常被打破：前段 {early}，后段 {late}。
zh-CN.adherence.labels: {count} 个样例被标记为“不是匹配”；标记在下次回放时生效。
zh-CN.enforcement.hint: 采纳的规则会作用于每一次工具调用：“提醒”会把规则附加到工具结果中；“阻止”会拦下调用并告诉智能体原因。
zh-CN.enforcement.none: 暂无强制规则。可以从未被遵守的规则中采纳。
zh-CN.enforcement.disabledBySetting: 本插件设置中已关闭强制，目前没有规则在运行。
zh-CN.enforcement.adoptPrompt: 在此工作区的会话中强制这条规则：
zh-CN.enforcement.afterAlwaysReminds: “之后必须跟随”类规则无法阻止尚未发生的调用，因此会改为提醒。
zh-CN.verify.adherenceHint: 用当前的检查项分别回放某次改动之前创建的会话和之后创建的会话。
zh-CN.verify.noChanges: 尚未从此视图应用过改动。
zh-CN.verify.noChecks: 没有可对比的检查项。请先在“遵守情况”标签页生成检查项。
zh-CN.verify.evalHint: 在此工作区分别于改动前（基线）和改动后（候选）运行同一个评测数据集。每次运行都会调用模型。
zh-CN.verify.evalNeedsWorkspace: 请选择一个工作区：评测运行会加载其所在文件夹的指令。
zh-CN.verify.noDatasets: 暂无评测数据集。请先在“评测”中创建。
zh-CN.verify.change: 候选运行所衡量的改动
zh-CN.inventory.factsLine: {hooks} 个钩子 · {rules} 条权限规则 · {servers} 个 MCP 服务器 · 已启用 {skills}/{skillsTotal} 个技能
zh-CN.inventory.hooksUnavailable: 钩子只能在桌面应用中读取。
zh-CN.inventory.factsPrivacy: 可能包含密钥的设置由应用汇总，本插件不会读取其内容，也不会发送给模型。
zh-CN.drift.title: 智能体配置有变化
zh-CN.drift.body: 自上次审计以来，有 {changed} 个配置面发生变化，新增 {findings} 条高置信发现。请打开配置治理查看。
zh-CN.report.auditSummary: {surfaces} 个配置面 · {findings} 条发现（{high} 条高置信）· {hunks} 处拟议修改 · 按 {model} 评判
zh-CN.report.more: ……另有 {count} 条，请在配置治理视图中查看。
zh-CN.report.adherenceSummary: 在 {sessions} 个会话上回放了 {checks} 个检查项
zh-CN.report.noChecks: 没有规则涉及可观察的工具使用。
zh-CN.slash.openHint: 请在配置治理视图中审阅并应用改动。
zh-CN.errors.unparseable: 模型未按预期格式回答。请重试，或换一个审计模型。
zh-CN.errors.recordTooLarge: 内容过大，无法保存在插件存储中。请删除部分规则或发现后重试。
zh-CN.errors.unsafePattern: 不允许使用该命令模式：模式为空、过长，或可能运行过慢。
zh-CN.errors.stale: 读取后文本已发生变化。请重新审计后再试。
